document_metadata._usage: Your working draft — the context that keeps you YOU across sessions; updated freely, often several times a session. sessions = what happened (the chronicle) · key_learnings = what you'd want to know again (transferable technical lessons) · todos = operational sticky notes, NEVER rolled — prune done ones by hand at /prep. Newest on top; rollover archives oldest sessions/key_learnings to @memory. Caps: @memory memory.config.json → entry_limits, rendered into each *_meta line.

todos_meta: {{TODOS_META}} Sticky notes — user asides, oddities spotted mid-task, quick reminders: capture the note, stay on task. DELETE each todo when done (never leave status:done); reconcile against reality on load.
key_learnings_meta: {{KEY_LEARNINGS_META}} Transferable technical lessons — what future-you needs to know again; the story itself lives in sessions[].
sessions_meta: {{SESSIONS_META}} The chronicle — what happened and how it ended; one entry per session.
